What Affliction is for

Timed damage that keeps paying out while you do something else. Improved CorruptionImproved CorruptionTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantReduces the casting time of your Corruption spell by 2 sec and increases the damage it deals by 10%. 5/5 makes CorruptionCorruptionLevel 4 · Spell · Shadow · Rank 1 of 7Cast2 sec castCost35 ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration12 secCorrupts the target, causing 40 Shadow damage over 12 sec. instant, and in Forever damage-over-time ticks can critically strike. Your damage keeps landing while you move, wand, FearFearLevel 8 · Spell · Shadow · Rank 1 of 3Cast1.5 sec castCost15% of base ManaRange20 yd rangeDuration10 secStrikes fear in the enemy, causing it to run in fear for up to 10 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect. Only 1 target can be feared at a time. a second enemy or Life TapLife TapLevel 6 · Spell · Shadow · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantConverts 30 Health into 30 Mana for you. Spirit increases the amount converted..

From 30 it sustains itself. Drain LifeDrain LifeLevel 14 · Spell · Shadow · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost55 ManaRange20 yd rangeDuration5 secTransfers 10 health every 1 second from the target to the caster. Lasts 5 sec. rank 3 heals back what Life TapLife TapLevel 6 · Spell · Shadow · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantConverts 30 Health into 30 Mana for you. Spirit increases the amount converted. costs. Wowhead: Affliction "rarely needs to stop to eat or drink", and the fastest way to play it is to pull two enemies, load one with effects and fear it, and kill the other.

Its weak point is a short fight. Both guide sites say an enemy that dies in a few seconds wastes the effects you put on it. Icy Veins rates the spec 5 out of 5 for levelling and 3.5 for dungeons (November 9). A levelling score measures solo kill speed and nothing else.

Wowhead names the costs: damage leans on Spell Power from gear, juggling two enemies takes keybinds and practice, and a feared enemy can run into another pack.

Your talent points

Both guide sites publish a 1 to 60 levelling build. Icy Veins prints its order point by point. Wowhead shows its build as an interactive calculator and describes it in words. They agree on the core and differ on what comes first.

Wowhead's no-respec build (November 11). The build itself is a calculator on Wowhead's levelling page; the page prints no point-by-point order. Levelling, one enemy (Wowhead, November 11). Use the Voidwalker until 20, then the Succubus or Incubus.

Wand or Drain LifeDrain LifeLevel 14 · Spell · Shadow · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost55 ManaRange20 yd rangeDuration5 secTransfers 10 health every 1 second from the target to the caster. Lasts 5 sec. before 30: Wowhead says a strong wand with little Spell Power wins, and more Spell Power moves it toward the drain. From rank 3 at 30 the drain "wins with any wand".

WrackWrackTalent · Rank 1CastInstantCost200 ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration6 secTears the target apart from within for 6 sec, inflicting 60 Shadow damage every 1 sec. Stat priority

The two guide sites order the damage stats differently.

Wowhead (November 11, from level-60 sim stat weights): Spell Power or Shadow damage, then critical strike, Hit to the cap, Haste, Spell Pierce, Intellect, Spirit.

Icy Veins (November 4): Hit to the cap, then Spell Power, critical strike, Haste, Intellect.

  • Hit cap: 17% against raid bosses and 4% against an enemy of your own level. SuppressionSuppressionTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantImproves your chance to hit by 5% and reduces all threat you generate by 20%. 5/5 gives 5%, so a raider needs 12% from gear and buffs. Past the cap Hit does nothing.
  • Critical strike counts for more than in Classic because ticks can crit. PandemicPandemicTalent · Rank 3 of 3CastInstantIncreases the critical strike damage bonus of your Corruption, Bane of Agony, Bane of Doom, Drain Soul, Drain Life, Siphon Life, and Wrack spells by 100%. 3/3 makes crits from CorruptionCorruptionLevel 4 · Spell · Shadow · Rank 1 of 7Cast2 sec castCost35 ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration12 secCorrupts the target, causing 40 Shadow damage over 12 sec., both Banes, Siphon LifeSiphon LifeLevel 30 · Spell · Shadow · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCost150 ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration30 secTransfers 11 health from the target to the caster every 3 sec. Lasts 30 sec., WrackWrackTalent · Rank 1CastInstantCost200 ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration6 secTears the target apart from within for 6 sec, inflicting 60 Shadow damage every 1 sec. While channeling, your Siphon Life, Corruption, and Bane of Agony effects on the target deal their periodic damage 100% faster. and both Drains deal double damage. ImmolateImmolateLevel 1 · Spell · Fire · Rank 1 of 8Cast2 sec castCost25 ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration15 secBurns the enemy for 11 Fire damage and then an additional 15 Fire damage over 15 sec. is not on its list.
  • Haste: Wowhead says it shortens casts and the global cooldown and does not speed up ticks, Drain LifeDrain LifeLevel 14 · Spell · Shadow · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost55 ManaRange20 yd rangeDuration5 secTransfers 10 health every 1 second from the target to the caster. Lasts 5 sec. or WrackWrackTalent · Rank 1CastInstantCost200 ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration6 secTears the target apart from within for 6 sec, inflicting 60 Shadow damage every 1 sec. While channeling, your Siphon Life, Corruption, and Bane of Agony effects on the target deal their periodic damage 100% faster.. Icy Veins' table says it shortens drain channels. The two disagree, and no Blizzard post settles it.
  • Spirit adds 1 Mana per point to every Life TapLife TapLevel 6 · Spell · Shadow · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantConverts 30 Health into 30 Mana for you. Spirit increases the amount converted.. Both sites still put it last or leave it off.
